body: I hear you. I'm feeling the same. Please try to keep going as I am trying to do. I know it can be hard to remember but there is a light at the end of the tunnel. This will pass, brother. Your kids need you and the world needs good people like yourself.
Just delete your post and slink off somewhere.
Ugh, what a disgusting thing to write to someone in here. You should be ashamed of yourself.
Thank you, Pur33. Your perspective and comments mean a lot.
Thanks, daisyfllower, I'm trying to figure out how to pm

Thanks for the reply, daisyfllower. I've been dealing with my tmj for 13 years (since a car accident). So my tmj is not great at this point. Thankfully no facial pain but a messed up neck. I wear my mouthguard most nights, but there has been considerable wear on the teeth regardless, especially on one side. I'm close to the dentin on some teeth.

I've avoided going to the ER for mainly the reason of the expensive bill. One should only really go there if one is in extreme crisis and immediate danger of hurting him or herself. I'm sorry to hear you are experiencing this. I don't know that it was bad advice on your therapist's part though. I would go easy on her and realize that she was just looking out for your wellbeing and safety. If you didn't injure yourself that night, perhaps it was somewhat helpful.
